description:
So a little history on Butter Pecan ice cream, why it "may" have come about and what it is, or can be. If you make this Butter Pecan ice cream either in your traditional ice cream machine or ninja creami, you will NOT be disappointed. 
Get that browned butter going, toast those pecans and get that brown sugar from the store. Whilst I did not use a stabilizer in this recipe, I would normally and it would make this a 100% perfect recipe, countering those eggs and the small amount of egg white that can sneak in. 

Get going on this one and if you have a Ninja Creami, get a piece of Pecan Pie, homemade or store bought and get that in there, IT'S INCREDIBLE!!

---------------------
Hige thanks to all my patreon supporters, you folk really keep me going past the negative comments and generally rude people here on YouTube. I love you all!

---------------------

Fancy Coffee Coffee Buzz Buzz Buzz? Check out this video: https://youtu.be/wNNmVsDADlc?si=NbAJAjZOhLiBjjCy

---------------------

How about Cornish/Devon Cream Tea ice cream? https://youtu.be/W3dY0p2rQBA?si=pmpeuVT-7oQeAic6 This will blow your mind!

alright I tried this recipe but my milk was 3% and my cream was 36% fat (it's usually 40% here) so I punched the numbers into an ice cream calculator and changed the proportions a bit to get the ice cream closer to 14% fat content (butter not included) 
so it ended up being around 420g of cream and 630g of milk... May have accidentally burnt the pecans a bit too but it wasn't too noticable.
Anyway, I finshed the recipe today and I wish I used at least some stabiliser cause it feels rather melty and like it's going to be hard to scoop once it sets fully (kind of like a hazel nut ice cream I made ages ago) but flavour-wise it tastes like a salted caramel frappe from McDo... I'm not complaining, cause now I have more reasons not to give that evil corporation any money!
I'll have to revisit this recipe at some point with proper home made vanilla paste in the future!!
